mentions.author: kaosjester
mentions.story: Building a Lisp from scratch with Swift
mentions.text: You can build a CEK machine ( [course]), switching from big-step operational semantics to small-step operational semantics. Then you dump the CEK machine in a while loop that runs until the continuation is empty and the code is a value. (On a side note, this is how most C-targeting Scheme implementations work.)
